name: Append Image to Document
description: Appends an image to the end of a document. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertInlineImageRequest)

configurable_props.name: docId
configurable_props.label: Document
configurable_props.description: Search for and select a document. You can also use a custom expression to pass a value from a previous step (e.g., `{{steps.foo.$return_value.documentId}}`) or you can enter a static ID (e.g., `1KuEN7k8jVP3Qi0_svM5OO8oEuiLkq0csihobF67eat8`).

configurable_props.name: imageUri
configurable_props.label: Image URL
configurable_props.description: The URL of the image you want to insert into the doc

configurable_props.name: appendAtBeginning
configurable_props.label: Append at Beginning
configurable_props.description: Whether to append at the beginning (`true`) of the document or at the end (`false`). Defaults to `false`
